column3: Close to the Hebrew; “tell” is rendered “Speak of.”
Close to the Hebrew; “boast” is rendered “Glory.”
Close to the Hebrew; “signs” is rendered “marvels,” and NASB adds “uttered” (“the judgments uttered by His mouth”).
Close to the Hebrew; “he remembers” is rendered “He has remembered.”
NASB adds “The covenant” at the start of the verse.
Close to the Hebrew; “like a little” is rendered “Very few,” and “sojourners” as “strangers.”
Close to the Hebrew; “on them” is rendered “for their sakes.”
“Iron came [into] his neck (or soul)” is rendered “He himself was laid in irons.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “to pass” (“his word came to pass”).
Close to the Hebrew; “master of his household” is rendered “lord of his house.”
“To bind his officials by his will” is rendered “To imprison his princes at will,” and NASB makes the second line a purpose clause (“That he might teach”).
Close to the Hebrew; “the words of his signs” is rendered “His wondrous acts,” and “wonders” as “miracles.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “Even” before “in the chambers.”
